name: Hierarchy of Needs

frame.name: Guidance Ring
frame.description: Precision hits and final blows build Guidance Ring energy. Opposing Guardians grant additional energy. At full charge, hip firing creates a Guidance Ring.

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.description:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.description:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Apollonic Tangent
perks.description: Arrows fired through a Guidance Ring release seeking projectiles, which scorch targets and do more damage based on distance traveled. Precision hits help guide these seekers toward their targets.

flavor: "I have peered through the eye of Chronos to divine humanity's path into the future." —Soteria, the Augurmind

catalyst.name: Hierarchy of Needs Catalyst
catalyst.description: Deploying a Guidance Ring or striking a target with a seeking projectile improves draw time, hip-fire accuracy, and reload speed for a moderate duration.
